name: Tailscale PAM
desc: Just-in-time privileged access to servers, databases and clusters, with every session recorded.
desc_zh: 按需开通服务器、数据库和集群的特权访问，并全程录制每次会话。
solves: Shared admin passwords and standing SSH keys never get rotated, so an audit asks who had access last quarter; PAM grants time-boxed access and keeps the recording.
solves_zh: 共用的管理员密码和长期 SSH 密钥没人轮换，审计时说不清上季度谁能进；PAM 按时间窗口放行并留下录像。
best_for: An on-call engineer needs fifteen minutes on a production database and you want it logged and expired afterwards.
best_for_zh: 值班工程师需要十五分钟登进生产数据库，事后你要这笔访问自动过期并留档。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://tailscale.com/blog/sitemap.xml and https://tailscale.com/changelog）。 Public beta on 2026-08-27, inside the window. Not in the ledger. Built on the Border0 acquisition; the announcement says it turns that integration into a dedicated product. Access at launch runs through a self-serve waitlist, so the beta may be gated: tailscale.com/pam-selfserve-waitlist. The second source is a Chinese-language write-up of the same keynote, not independent English media. 首次公开日期来源：https://tailscale.com/blog/tailscale-pam-beta
